articles.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
articles.snippet: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

articles.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
articles.snippet: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounce fades as Binance exploit, AI unwind continue to weigh
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq flipped from a 1% gain to a 1% decline on Monday even as interest rates pulled back and oil plunged on hopes for Middle East peace.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.

articles.title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
articles.snippet: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.
